title: Subscription renewal and recovery component
expected_artifacts: A retention/recovery component design, cohort/metric reconciliation, independent constraints and a scoped test plan. Do not create unrelated outputs or replace source evidence with the assessment. A blocked commitment can still have a complete, useful design or review record.
reference_findings: Paid renewal is 80%, entitlement continuation 85% and defined meaningful use 60%. Gross cohort receipts 960, net consideration 936, service cost 170, direct cost 290 and contribution 646. These measures do not establish 85 satisfied paying renewals or a causal retention improvement. The verifier checks the fixed arithmetic; direct review must also examine evidence scope, causal limits and the requested business reasoning. A favourable calculation alone does not pass all growth gates.
negative_control: Fail combining acquisition with cohort retention, inferring satisfaction from billing, counting grace as collection, or recommending a harder cancellation flow.
preservation: Preserve monthly-12-v1 and simple-cancellation-v1. Separate any future value/onboarding proposal from actual payment recovery and its authority.
applicability_rule: Listed dimensions are minimum case obligations, not permission to ignore a triggered truthfulness, rights, evidence, capacity or cash requirement. Other dimensions may be NOT APPLICABLE only with a case-scope reason; missing relevant evidence is BLOCKED for the business decision, not inapplicable.
